name: Charles Bronson
description: '''Charles Bronson''' was an American [[powerviolence]] band from [[DeKalb, Illinois]], active from 1994 to 1997. Formed by vocalist Mark McCoy and Jon Arends, the group played very short, fast songs with lyrics that satirized the [[hardcore punk]] scene. It released one album, ''[[Youth Attack!]]'' (1997), along with a series of singles and split records, later collected on the double CD ''[[Complete Discocrappy]]''.
